snippet.title: The Road Of Dust And Sorrow | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now!
Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3895110/The_Road_of_Dust_and_Sorrow/
PS5 https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019736
XBOX https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/the-road-of-dust-and-sorrow/9p40542lmbwp

The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards
